_comment: Alert thresholds for the Workspace deployment. They live HERE and not in the process because 'how late is too late' is a deployment's decision, and a number compiled into the code would fork from the rule that fires on it. READ deploy/README.md before treating this file as monitoring: the foundation's own renderer says the catalogue is RENDERABLE DEFINITIONS, not operational alerting — zero rules are connected to an evaluator or a routing path anywhere in this fleet, and the Workspace additionally runs no collector at all (deploy/product.toml [telemetry] declares logs/metrics/traces false). Every placeholder must resolve before the file can render, so values are supplied for rules this deployment has no producer for; that is a property of the catalogue, not a claim of coverage. Values follow dotmac_erp:deploy/alerts/thresholds.json rather than being invented per product, so two Dotmac deployments do not disagree about the same rule for no reason — EXCEPT the three backup numbers, which are the Workspace fleet backup's real targets rather than the fleet default: hourly dumps (RPO 1h), alert at two intervals (2h since the newest semantically validated backup), and a weekly restore drill. ProductDeploymentSpec.v1 has no cadence field, so this file is the only place the interval can be stated at all.
